description: A mod that adds mos6502 based microcontrollers to the Minecraft so you can automate your redstone contraptions with assembly code.

mods.name: CodeNode Microcontrollers
mods.description: Adds redstone microcontrollers powered by 6502 processors. Automate your projects in 6502 assembly!

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Use json block models instead of mod's custom .ply loader by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/21
* Be able to move documentation window and moved menu bar by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/22
* Fix redstone connectivity for the pins of the MCU by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/23
* Be able to load and save files, and added a backup system to prevent loss of work by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/24


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/compare/0.0.9a-1.20.4...0.0.10a-1.20.4

## What's Changed
* Always use latest release for changelog by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/14
* Add event listener (EL) module to Nano MCU by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/15
* Fix the toolchain config not being able to load defaults correctly by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/16
* Added the UART module to MCUs to communicate through serial by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/17
* Added quick references for the EL and UART module by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/19


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/compare/0.0.8a-1.20.4...0.0.9a-1.20.4

## What's Changed
* Use happly to load ply files instead of assimp by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/8

* Allow model to rebake/reload by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/10
* Adds toojchain settings including setting custom build variables and environment variables by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/11
* User is able to view registers in decimal or hexidemal format by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/12
* allow user to refresh the config by @elmfrain in https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/pull/13


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/elmfrain/cnmcu/compare/0.0.7a-1.20.4...0.0.8a-1.20.4
